title: Token 活动日桶、零用户 Key 搜索授权与模型图片能力合同

root_cause.usage: The existing identity projection exposed only the current UTC-week total. The authoritative e_mate_model_usage_attempt ledger already retained per-attempt token dimensions and recorded_at, but no account-scoped timezone day projection consumed it, so T11 had no legal source for a heatmap.
root_cause.search: The identity client requested the released 2.0.14 runtime-model contract while Model Gateway admitted only 2.0.12 and 2.0.13. That rejected the existing T05 managed-search grant before its single native credential route could be projected.
root_cause.image_capability: Runtime model input modalities already crossed the enterprise catalog into the pinned Harness adapter, but the Profile exposed no stable tri-state decision for T15. Without one, a later image repair could regress to model-name or UI heuristics.

resolution.usage: identity.usage.activity now validates a strict IANA timezone and inclusive Gregorian range of at most 366 days, reads only the existing account usage-attempt ledger, fills empty dates, preserves input/output/cache dimensions as canonical decimal strings, checks period totals and returns typed unavailable without private upstream details.
resolution.weekly_compatibility: identity.usage is unchanged. UTC overlap fixtures reconcile its safe-integer weekly total with the new decimal-string daily projection over the same ledger.
resolution.search: Model Gateway now admits 2.0.14 and 2.0.15 while retaining 2.0.12/2.0.13 compatibility. The existing reserved T05 route remains the sole grant authority; granted installs only E_MATE_SEARCH_KEY_DEEPSEEK, while denied, unavailable, revoke and offline states remove or preserve absence of that ref without dropping model credentials or usage access.
resolution.image_capability: The existing emateModelPolicy service now resolves the exact session-selected provider/model through native LLM metadata and returns image-capable, text-only or unknown. image-capable and unknown require preserve-native; only authoritative text-only returns convert-at-request-boundary. The contract receives no image block and cannot mutate durable Attachments.
resolution.etag: The activity endpoint emits a weak ETag over stable bucket data; late ledger facts change the validator while calculated_at alone does not invalidate an equivalent cached bucket projection.
